arguments.recommended_next_step: Review the ingress configuration to increase the idle timeout, and ensure that the cron jobs are running correctly in UTC time. Address the growing failed-jobs backlog by identifying and resolving the root cause of the job failures.
arguments.summary: Investigated several potential causes for the 502 errors, including disk full, CDN cache issues, and certificate expiration. None of these were the actual cause. The issue turned out to be an ingress idle timeout of 30 seconds. The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing, and the failed_jobs table has been exported for the postmortem.
